numberSetup.title: Get your phone number
numberSetup.description: Your AI receptionist needs a number to answer. Choose how you want to get one.
numberSetup.ownerOnly: Only an owner or admin can change the business phone number.

buy.title: Get a number from HelmSmart
buy.subtitle: A new number your receptionist answers straight away
buy.how: We buy the number and connect it to your AI receptionist in one step, so it starts answering the moment you have it.
buy.cost: This is a purchase. It adds a phone number to your account, billed every month for as long as you keep it — toll-free numbers cost more than local ones. Nothing is bought until you press the button below.
buy.areaCodeHelp: Use the area code your customers recognise, and we'll find an available number in it. For a toll-free number, use a toll-free prefix such as 800, 888 or 877.
buy.failed: Couldn't get a number right now.

forward.title: Keep your current business number
forward.subtitle: Forward your existing line to HelmSmart at your phone provider
forward.how: HelmSmart doesn't forward calls — your phone provider does. You get a HelmSmart number, then tell your carrier to send calls from your existing line to it. Your customers keep dialling the number you already advertise.
forward.step1: Get a HelmSmart number first. That's the number your calls will be forwarded to.
forward.step2: Open the app or online account for the carrier your business line is with.
forward.step3: Turn on call forwarding to your HelmSmart number. Most carriers let you forward every call, or only the ones you don't pick up — forwarding only unanswered calls lets your own phone ring first.
forward.step4: Call your business number from another phone to check the receptionist answers.
forward.carrierNote: How you switch forwarding on differs by carrier. On many US mobile carriers it's *72 followed by the number to start and *73 to stop, but check your own provider's instructions — landlines, VoIP and business phone systems each do it differently.

import.title: Advanced — connect a Twilio number you own
import.subtitle: For accounts with their own Twilio Elastic SIP Trunk
import.how: If you already own a number in your own Twilio account, we can point it at your receptionist over its SIP trunk. The trunk has to be set up in Twilio first. Most businesses want one of the options above instead.
import.phoneNumberHelp: In full international form, including the country code — for example +16265551234.
import.terminationUriHelp: From your Twilio Elastic SIP Trunk, under Termination — for example yourtrunk.pstn.twilio.com.
import.sipAuthHelp: Only needed if your trunk authenticates with credentials. Leave both blank if it authenticates by IP address.
